markets.rules_primary: If a player from a conference other than the SEC, Big Ten, ACC, Big 12 or FBS Independents (Notre Dame and UConn) is selected as a finalist for the Heisman Trophy in the 2026 college football season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on whether a player from any conference other than the Power 4 (SEC, Big Ten, ACC, and Big 12) or FBS Independents (Notre Dame and UConn) is selected as a finalist for the 2026 Heisman Trophy as reported by one of the Source Agencies. In the event that finalists are not announced and reported by one of the Source Agencies prior to the award winner being announced, then all markets resolve to No.

Note: Conference designation is based on the conference of the team that the 2026 Heisman Trophy finalists represent at the time the finalists are officially announced. If a player transfers during the season, their conference designation will be based on the team they are on when the finalists are announced.
